text:
ashley: Hey team — HelixMed just reported their ACH microdeposit never arrived and their bank returned an error when we tried to verify. customer on a live onboarding, invoice 98321 is past due. can we escalate? :frowning:

maria: saw the failure logs: bank returned `ACH_ERROR: ACCOUNT_TYPE_MISMATCH` on setup attempts. looks like they submitted a business account but bank flagged it as personal in their system. this is probably why microdeposits rejected.

josh: Ugh. Do we have any alternate verification steps? doc upload? bank login?

maria: We can ask for a bank statement upload (pdf) OR switch to a one-time wire. microdeposits usually take 3-5 business days and may fail repeatedly if bank metadata mismatches.

ashley: Customer is requesting wire now — they said they need access to production this week. invoice total is $248,394. wire would clear faster.

kevin: From sales: HelixMed is in final contract stage for a bigger seat expansion. they want to avoid delays. I'm okay with wire if finance signs off on manual settlement and we document it.

maria: Two operational notes: 1) we need manager approval for a manual wire settlement for amounts > $100k, 2) we must attach KYC docs and a signed ACK from the customer accepting one-time wire terms.

billing-bot: invoice 98321 status -> PAST_DUE. last attempted payment method: ACH ending 6789. attempts: 3. next auto-retry: disabled (escalated).

josh: Linda from Finance — can you weigh in? need a quick decision so we can send wiring instructions.

linda: I'm fine approving a one-time wire for this customer contingent on: (a) signed ACK of one-time wire and refund policy, (b) copy of bank statement showing name match, (c) compliance quick-check. please collect docs and post here. once docs are attached i'll sign off and release our wire instructions. :thumbsup:

ashley: I'll ping the customer for docs now and attach when received. prepping our wire info template — will redact until approval.

maria: once we have the bank statement & signed ack, i'll post the redacted wiring instructions (account masked) and the finance team will confirm release time. recommend we also set a manual flag on the account to prevent auto-cancellation while they pay.

kevin: noted, i'll hold the onboarding enablement until finance confirms receipt of funds.

ashley: Sending docs request now. thanks all. :pray:

[thread closed for update — follow-ups will be new thread once docs arrive]
